research_question: State one falsifiable cross-sectional or event prediction.

seed_lineage.selection_reason: Causal fit, data feasibility, novelty, execution plausibility, and falsifiability only.

mechanism.market_failure: Describe the risk, behavior, information delay, or microstructure friction.
causal_chain: Cause changes observable information or trading pressure.
The market incorporates it slowly or with a predictable distortion.
The distortion predicts returns over the frozen horizon.
mechanism.falsifiable_prediction: State subset, direction, signal time, and horizon.

data_contract.identity_rule: Venue name, category, chain, and contract address agree with the issuer mapping.
data_contract.signal_time_rule: Use only fields available before rebalance.
data_contract.entry_rule: First permitted executable bar after frozen delay.
data_contract.exit_rule: First permitted executable bar at or after holding horizon.

reject_if: Any future join or same-bar execution is detected.
Baseline or stress cost gate fails.
The result is redundant with an existing signal.
retest_only_if: A new independent venue is available.
A previously missing first-party field becomes available.
